27502857.source: END-AF (PMID 27502857) abstract: 'consecutive patients ... scheduled to undergo elective cardiac surgery (n = 360) were randomized ... The primary end point of AF occurred in 63 patients (17.5%): 26 (14.5%) in the colchicine group and 37 (20.5%) in the no-colchicine group (relative risk reduction 29.3% [P = .14])'. n=360 randomized 1:1 => 180 per arm; 26/180=14.4% and 37/180=20.6% corroborate the stated 14.5% and 20.5%. Extractor could not auto-pool: the per-arm denominator (180) is implied by n=360 1:1 + the percentages, not stated, and 'no-colchicine' is not a comparator term.
27502857.verification: Abstract %-corroborated (26/180=14.4%, 37/180=20.6%); RR 26/37=0.703 => RRR 29.7% matches the stated 29.3%.
